description: This Java class 'SeoConfigUtil' provides utilities for parsing, handling, and managing SEO-related configuration settings sourced from 'SeoConfig.xml'. It supports pattern matching, URL rewriting, redirect management, and session ID configurations, tailored for SEO optimization within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SeoConfigUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing SEO configuration settings, including URL patterns, replacements, session ID handling, and redirection rules based on 'SeoConfig.xml' configuration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Loads and parses the 'SeoConfig.xml' configuration file, initializing regex patterns, SEO rules, URL patterns, session ID rules, and other SEO-related settings.

methods.name: isInitialed
methods.description: Checks if the SEO configuration has been successfully loaded and initialized.

methods.name: checkUseUrlRegexp
methods.description: Indicates whether URL regular expressions are enabled based on the loaded configuration.

methods.name: getGeneralRegexpPattern
methods.description: Returns the general regex pattern used for matching URLs, if specified.

methods.name: checkCategoryUrl
methods.description: Determines if category URL rewriting is enabled.

methods.name: isCategoryUrlEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific context path is allowed for category URL rewriting.

methods.name: isCategoryNameEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether category name display is enabled.

methods.name: getCategoryUrlSuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix used for category URLs.

methods.name: isJSessionIdAnonEnabled
methods.description: Checks if JSESSIONID is enabled for anonymous sessions.

methods.name: isJSessionIdUserEnabled
methods.description: Checks if JSESSIONID is enabled for logged-in users.

methods.name: getUserExceptionPatterns
methods.description: Provides a list of regex patterns for URLs that are exceptions to JSESSIONID rules.

methods.name: getCharFilters
methods.description: Returns character filter patterns used for URL encoding or sanitization.

methods.name: getSeoPatterns
methods.description: Provides the map of URL patterns to regex Pattern objects for SEO URL rewriting.

methods.name: getSeoReplacements
methods.description: Returns the map of URL patterns to their SEO replacement strings.

methods.name: getForwardReplacements
methods.description: Returns URL patterns to redirection replacements.

methods.name: getForwardResponseCodes
methods.description: Returns the map of URL patterns to HTTP response codes for redirects.

methods.name: isSpecialProductId
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if a product ID is designated as special for SEO URL processing.

methods.name: addSpecialProductId
methods.description: Deprecated method to add a product ID to the list of special product IDs for SEO handling.

methods.name: getSpecialProductId
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve the original product ID from a special product ID.

methods.name: getDefaultResponseCode
methods.description: Returns the default HTTP response code used for redirects.
